moments.title: Arsenal score from Ødegaard’s set piece
moments.summary: Martin Ødegaard’s delivery found Gabriel Magalhães, who headed Arsenal in front.

actions.label: Deliver the cross
actions.outcome: The delivery reaches Gabriel in the box. This branch explores a different outcome for the header.

actions.label: Play short
actions.detail: Keep the set piece on the ground
actions.outcome: Arsenal work a short routine and try to open a new crossing angle.

actions.label: Shoot from the second ball
actions.outcome: The ball is recycled to the edge of the area for a first-time attempt.

actions.label: Recycle possession
actions.outcome: Arsenal retain the ball and rebuild the attack from a safer position.

moments.title: Salah gets in behind and levels
moments.summary: Trent Alexander-Arnold’s long pass released Mohamed Salah, who moved inside Zinchenko and finished.

actions.label: Shoot early
actions.outcome: Salah takes the first-time route; the branch outcome is an illustrative alternate, not a replay of the real finish.

actions.label: Take on Zinchenko
actions.outcome: Salah carries the ball inside and forces the covering defenders to react.

actions.label: Slip a runner through
actions.detail: Look for a teammate in the channel
actions.outcome: Salah releases a forward runner instead of taking on the shot himself.

actions.label: Hold up and reset
actions.outcome: Liverpool keep possession and bring more players into the attack.

moments.title: Liverpool’s triple change reshapes the attack
moments.summary: Darwin Núñez, Harvey Elliott and Ryan Gravenberch came on. The Premier League analysis discusses Klopp moving Salah centrally after the change.

actions.label: Keep Salah wide
actions.outcome: Salah stays on the right and Liverpool keep attacking the one-v-one.

actions.label: Move Salah inside
actions.detail: Add a runner through the middle
actions.outcome: Salah moves centrally while the right side is occupied by a supporting runner.

actions.label: Target Núñez early
actions.outcome: Liverpool look for Núñez in the channel before Arsenal can settle.

actions.label: Keep the structure
actions.detail: Make the changes without forcing the shape
actions.outcome: Liverpool retain their width and wait for a clearer opening.

moments.title: Liverpool’s five-on-two counter from an Arsenal corner
moments.summary: The Premier League report describes a Liverpool counter after an Arsenal corner; Alexander-Arnold struck the crossbar from close range.

actions.label: Square it to Trent
actions.outcome: Trent receives in the central lane and gets a close-range attempt away.

actions.label: Release Núñez
actions.detail: Use the runner beyond the defence
actions.outcome: Núñez is sent into the space behind the retreating defenders.

actions.label: Carry the ball forward
actions.outcome: Salah drives at the remaining defender before choosing the final action.

actions.label: Go for goal yourself
actions.detail: Take the chance before the defence recovers
actions.outcome: Salah shoots rather than waiting for the supporting runners.
